rationale: v1-failure-catalog 完整保留 baseline (SC1-5 / HR1-10 / RF1-11 / RT1-10 / honeypot) 并新增 10 个 Failure Mode Catalog (FM-1..FM-10),每个 FM 都有 machine-detectable 的 detect: (regex / mtime / grep / dirname) + 可执行 recovery: (auto-rename / mtime double-check / TaskCreate 转换 / mv / superseded 标记),清晰区分了 SC(入口闸)/ RF(写盘前可见信号)/ FM(状态级灾难)三层防线。actionability 升到 0.91 (+0.07)、enforcement 升到 0.92 (+0.09)、integration 略升到 0.80 (FM-1/7/8 触及跨项目/feedback 矛盾/judgment-tree 兜底)。代价是体积 +19% (266→317),volume_efficiency 跌到 0.65。加权 aggregate = 0.842,delta = +0.039 < 阈值 +0.05,判定 no_improvement,no_improvement_counter += 1 → 2。方向正确(post-write 灾难拦截补齐了 baseline 缺口)但单变体增量不足以越过门槛,下一轮可考虑下沉 FM 详细 detect/recovery 到 references/failure-modes.md 留主文骨架来恢复 volume_efficiency。
